narration: In month {fork_month}, two job offers arrived at once and only one could be kept. You took {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. The layoff came in month {widest_gap_month}, and at that low point the ghost had {widest_gap}. By month {end_month}, less of the ghost's pay was committed before each month began, with its Freedom {freedom_gap}. Both lives ended only getting by, with Life {life_gap}. The ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
